title.rendered: Education and Technology Conference for Families

content.rendered: Engage Oregon will be hosting a “tailgater” conference on October 20, 2017  in the commons of Sherwood High School at 5:30 pm prior to the football game.  The conference will focus on the Digital Age: privacy, parenting, and classrooms.  Please see here: English or  here: Spanish for more information.
